scope: Numerical revision after v1 AMP overflow at epoch132: six fresh head-only fits, same initial head/seed for both modes; no continuation or mixing with v1 outputs. Twelve branch/mode/budget cells; no encoder/test.

training.schedule: Original E03P 30-epoch 10%-warmup/cosine prefix, then its terminal LR 0.0001 held constant through epoch200. Never stretch cosine over 200 epochs.
training.fresh_initialization: All six conditions reset to the same parent initial head and training seed20043; both modes use fixed loss scale1024.
training.checkpoint_selection: Highest validation Macro-F1 within each budget; earliest exact tie; also report exact epoch30/epoch200 endpoints.
training.loss_scale_policy: Fixed1024 for all epochs/conditions, growth_interval1000000000; nonfinite gradients still abort, no skipped-step fallback or silent retry.

interventions.fanin_gain: Fresh shared head, global input gain sqrt(1039/active_branches); one active branch for statistics/moment, two for fusion. Relative within-branch normalization and inter-branch balance unchanged.
interventions.head: Unchanged LayerNorm(moment)/sqrt(1024), train-fitted statistics/sqrt(15), zero excluded branch, Linear1039to128/GELU/dropout0.1/Linear128to3. Same nominal parameters, not equal effective capacity.
interventions.legacy_fresh: Fresh original geometry with gain1 and fixed loss scale1024; compare its own prefix30 and extended200, not a reused dynamic-scale parent.

diagnostic_rules.interpretation: Per branch, flag useful extra budget when best200-best30>=1pp and endpoint200-endpoint30>=0.5pp. Flag early scale sensitivity when gain_best30-legacy_best30>=1pp. These are conditional diagnostics, not unique-cause or external confirmation.

candidate_rules.comparison: Fusion best200 versus max(parent pretrained fusion SVM, parent matched statistics SVM, all diagnostic statistics/moment best200); also versus same-mode moment best200.

limitations: E03P validation outcomes already seen and used to motivate this diagnostic. Single data seed, validation reused up to200 epochs, so selection opportunity differs across budgets. Report endpoints and training loss alongside best scores. No claim of new independent evidence, fully converged heads, universal scaling fix, or recovered LoRA advantage. The original failed E03P gate remains unchanged.
numerical_revision: V1 stopped on nonfinite gradient at statistics_fanin_gain epoch132 after dynamic scale grew32768. V1 outputs and failed protocol remain intact; new numerical variant restarts all six cases, all scopes and thresholds unchanged. Reference validation already seen.
